content.json:
# BTP Overview Dashboard

This dashboard provides a birds-eye view of audit log activity across BTP accounts. This is intended to show the most active accounts and event sources, and general trends in activity.

Modify the Time Range selector to alter the lookback period and select the Identity Management tab to see more. The vulnerability posture KPI below requires the separate SAP BTP AVL connector — see the **Application Vulnerabilities** tab for full details.

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on UpdatedOn from {TimeRange:start} to now() step 1d by Tenant
| project-away UpdatedOn
| join kind = inner (SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
    | summarize Requests = count() by Tenant
    ) on Tenant
| project Tenant, Requests, Trend
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Most active accounts by events generated
Ingested events by audit category

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where Category == "audit.security-events"
| where Message has "UserAuthenticationSuccess"
| make-series Events = count() default = 0 on UpdatedOn from {TimeRange:start} to now() step 1d by Tenant
content.title: Successful user sign-in activity over time

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where Category == "audit.security-events"
| where Message has "Unauthorized access attempt"
| make-series Events = count() default = 0 on UpdatedOn from {TimeRange:start} to now() step 1d by Tenant
| extend (baseline) = series_decompose(Events)
| extend (anomalies, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(Events, 3, -1, 'linefit')
content.title: Business Application Studio sign-in: unauthorized access anomalies

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where Entities has "SAP BTP"
| make-series Events = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from {TimeRange:start} to now() step 1d
content.title: BTP Security alerts over time

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize Value = count()
content.title: Open vulnerability findings
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range. This KPI requires the separate SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) to be connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL — see the 'Application Vulnerabilities' tab.

content.title: Critical findings (CVSS >= 9)
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range. This KPI requires the separate SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) to be connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL — see the 'Application Vulnerabilities' tab.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize Value = dcount(AppId)
content.title: Vulnerable apps
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range. This KPI requires the separate SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) to be connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL — see the 'Application Vulnerabilities' tab.

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where UpdatedOn >= {TimeRange:start}
| where Message has "scim user"
| extend Action = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(Message.object)).id)).crudType)
| summarize Events = count() by UserName, Action
| evaluate pivot(Action, sum(Events)) : (UserName:string, CREATE:int, UPDATE:int, DELETE:int)
| extend Total = CREATE + UPDATE + DELETE
| order by Total desc
content.title: Top user account management events by user

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where UpdatedOn >= {TimeRange:start}
| where Message has "scim user"
| extend Action = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(Message.object)).id)).crudType)
| summarize count() by Tenant
content.title: User account management events by subaccount

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where UpdatedOn between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where Message has "scim user"
| extend Action = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(Message.object)).id)).crudType)
| summarize Events = count() by UserName, Action
| evaluate pivot(Action, sum(Events)) : (UserName:string, CREATE:int, UPDATE:int, DELETE:int)
| extend Events = CREATE + UPDATE + DELETE
| order by Events asc
content.title: Most rare user account management events by user

content.query:
let user_account_changes = materialize(SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
    | where UpdatedOn between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where isnotempty(Message.object)
    | where Message has "scim user"
    | extend Attributes = parse_json(Message.attributes)
    | mv-expand Attributes
    | where isnotempty(Attributes.new)
    | extend New = replace_regex(tostring(Attributes.new), "\\r", "")
    | extend Old = replace_regex(tostring(Attributes.old), "\\r", "")
    | extend Action = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(Message.object)).id)).crudType)
    | project UpdatedOn, UserName, Action, Tenant, New, Old);
let unpack_object = (Changes: (UpdatedOn: datetime, UserName: string, Tenant:string, Action: string, Column: string, Value: string)) {
    Changes
    | extend Column = parse_json(Column)
    | evaluate bag_unpack(Column): (
        UpdatedOn: datetime
        , UserName: string
        , Tenant: string
        , Action: string
        , Value: string
        , userName: string
        , active: string
        , emails: string
        , externalId: string
        , id: string
        , meta: string
        , name: string
        , origin: string
        , passwordLastModified: datetime
        , verified: string
        , zoneid: string)
};
let old_user = user_account_changes
    | project-away New
    | project-rename Column = Old
    | extend Value = "Old"
    | where not (Action == "CREATE" and Value == "Old");
let new_user = user_account_changes
    | project-away Old
    | project-rename Column = New
    | extend Value = "New";
union (unpack_object(old_user)), (unpack_object(new_user))
| where UserName !startswith "sb-"
| order by UpdatedOn desc, Value asc
content.title: User account management activity

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where UpdatedOn between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where Message has_any ("xs_rolecollection2user", "xsrolecollection2role", "xsrolecollections")
| where UserName != "client/hcp_onboarding"
| extend ChangeId = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(Message.object).id))
| evaluate bag_unpack(ChangeId)
| project-away TimeGenerated, Message, MessageUuid, OrgId, SpaceId, AlsServiceId, Category, Type, TenantId, _ResourceId
| project-reorder UpdatedOn, UserName
content.title: Security role collection management events

content.json:
# BTP Audit Coverage

This view identifies custom BTP applications that have user logins but no business audit trail. These applications may be missing audit log service bindings or `@AuditLog` annotations, creating security blind spots where user actions are invisible to monitoring.

content.query:
let platform_service_patterns = dynamic([
    "app-studio", "auditlog", "cis-local", "service-manager",
    "destination-xsappname", "connectivity-proxy", "feature-flags"
]);
let base = materialize(SAPBTPAuditLog_CL | where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start});
let app_logins = base
    | where Category == "audit.security-events"
    | extend data_s = tostring(Message.data)
    | where data_s has "TokenIssuedEvent"
    | extend ParsedData = parse_json(data_s)
    | extend ClientId = tostring(ParsedData.origin)
    | where ClientId startswith "sb-"
    | extend EventMessage = tostring(ParsedData.message)
    | extend GrantType = extract(@'"grant_type"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, EventMessage)
    | where GrantType == "authorization_code"
    | extend XsAppName = extract(@"^sb-(.+?)!\w+$", 1, ClientId)
    | where isnotempty(XsAppName)
    | where not(XsAppName has_any (platform_service_patterns))
    | extend AppName = extract(@"^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)", 1, XsAppName)
    | extend HumanUser = extract(@'"user_name"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, EventMessage);
let audited_by_sb = base
    | where Category !in ("audit.security-events")
    | where UserName startswith "sb-"
    | extend AuditedAppName = extract(@"^sb-(.+?)!\w+", 1, UserName)
    | where isnotempty(AuditedAppName)
    | distinct AuditedAppName, Tenant;
let audited_by_binding = base
    | where Category == "audit.security-events"
    | where UserName contains "customer-auditlog"
    | where isnotempty(AlsServiceId)
    | distinct AlsServiceId, Tenant;
let all_apps_summary = app_logins
    | summarize
        LoginCount = count(),
        FirstLogin = min(TimeGenerated),
        LastLogin = max(TimeGenerated),
        Users = make_set(HumanUser, 100)
        by AppName, XsAppName, AlsServiceId, SubaccountName, Tenant;
let audited_xsappnames = union
    (audited_by_sb | project XsAppName = AuditedAppName, Tenant),
    (audited_by_binding
        | join kind=inner (all_apps_summary | distinct XsAppName, AlsServiceId, Tenant) on AlsServiceId, Tenant
        | project XsAppName, Tenant)
    | distinct XsAppName, Tenant;
all_apps_summary
| join kind=leftouter (audited_xsappnames | extend IsAudited = true) on XsAppName, Tenant
| extend AuditStatus = iff(IsAudited == true, "Audited", "Unaudited")
| project AppName, XsAppName, SubaccountName, Tenant, AuditStatus, LoginCount, FirstLogin, LastLogin, Users
| order by AuditStatus asc, LoginCount desc
content.title: Custom app audit coverage

content.query:
let platform_service_patterns = dynamic([
    "app-studio", "auditlog", "cis-local", "service-manager",
    "destination-xsappname", "connectivity-proxy", "feature-flags"
]);
let base = materialize(SAPBTPAuditLog_CL | where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start});
let app_logins = base
    | where Category == "audit.security-events"
    | extend data_s = tostring(Message.data)
    | where data_s has "TokenIssuedEvent"
    | extend ParsedData = parse_json(data_s)
    | extend ClientId = tostring(ParsedData.origin)
    | where ClientId startswith "sb-"
    | extend EventMessage = tostring(ParsedData.message)
    | extend GrantType = extract(@'"grant_type"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, EventMessage)
    | where GrantType == "authorization_code"
    | extend XsAppName = extract(@"^sb-(.+?)!\w+$", 1, ClientId)
    | where isnotempty(XsAppName)
    | where not(XsAppName has_any (platform_service_patterns))
    | distinct XsAppName, AlsServiceId, Tenant;
let audited_by_sb = base
    | where Category !in ("audit.security-events")
    | where UserName startswith "sb-"
    | extend AuditedAppName = extract(@"^sb-(.+?)!\w+", 1, UserName)
    | where isnotempty(AuditedAppName)
    | distinct AuditedAppName, Tenant;
let audited_by_binding = base
    | where Category == "audit.security-events"
    | where UserName contains "customer-auditlog"
    | where isnotempty(AlsServiceId)
    | distinct AlsServiceId, Tenant;
let audited_xsappnames = union
    (audited_by_sb | project XsAppName = AuditedAppName, Tenant),
    (audited_by_binding
        | join kind=inner (app_logins) on AlsServiceId, Tenant
        | project XsAppName, Tenant)
    | distinct XsAppName, Tenant;
let total_apps = app_logins | summarize Total = dcount(XsAppName);
let audited_count = audited_xsappnames
| join kind=inner (app_logins | distinct XsAppName, Tenant) on XsAppName, Tenant
| summarize Audited = dcount(XsAppName);
total_apps
| extend placeholder = 1
| join kind=leftouter (audited_count | extend placeholder = 1) on placeholder
| extend Audited = coalesce(Audited, 0)
| extend Unaudited = Total - Audited
| extend AuditedPct = iff(Total == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Audited / Total, 1))
| project Score = iff(Total == 0, "No custom app logins in range", strcat(Audited, " / ", Total, " apps audited (", AuditedPct, "%)")), AuditedPct
content.title: Audit coverage score

content.json:
# Application Vulnerabilities

> **Requires the SAP BTP Application Vulnerability (AVL) connector** — this tab visualizes findings from the `SAPBTPAVL_CL` table, populated by the separate SAP Application Vulnerability Report Service connector (`SAPBTPAVL`). If only the SAP BTP audit log connector is connected, this tab will show no data until the AVL connector is also deployed.

This view surfaces vulnerability findings (vulnerable open-source packages, high CVSS CVEs) in custom applications deployed on SAP BTP, so risky apps can be prioritized for remediation.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize Value = count()
content.title: Open findings
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range. Confirm the SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) is connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL.

content.title: Critical findings (CVSS ≥ threshold)
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range. Confirm the SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) is connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize Value = dcount(AppId)
content.title: Vulnerable apps
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range. Confirm the SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) is connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize LastIngested = max(TimeGenerated)
| extend MinutesSinceLastIngest = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastIngested)
| project MinutesSinceLastIngest
content.title: Minutes since last ingest
content.noDataMessage: No AVL data ingested in the last 30 days. Confirm the SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) is connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize Findings = count() by Severity
| order by Findings desc
content.title: Findings by severity
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| extend AgeDays = datetime_diff('day', now(), FirstFound)
| extend AgeBucket = case(
    AgeDays <= 7, "0-7 days",
    AgeDays <= 30, "8-30 days",
    AgeDays <= 90, "31-90 days",
    "90+ days")
| summarize Findings = count() by AgeBucket
| extend SortOrder = case(
    AgeBucket == "0-7 days", 1,
    AgeBucket == "8-30 days", 2,
    AgeBucket == "31-90 days", 3,
    4)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project-away SortOrder
content.title: Remediation backlog (age since first found)
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize NewFindings = count() by bin(FirstFound, 1d), Severity
| order by FirstFound asc
content.title: New findings over time by severity (first found date)
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range.

content.query:
let critical_threshold = todouble('{CvssThreshold}');
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize
    Findings = count(),
    CriticalFindings = countif(MaxCvss >= critical_threshold),
    HighestCvss = max(MaxCvss)
    by AppName, SubaccountName
| top 10 by Findings desc
content.title: Top 10 vulnerable applications (by open finding count)
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| project
    FindingId,
    AppName,
    SubaccountName,
    Severity,
    MaxCvss,
    ActiveCves,
    PackageNames,
    Recommendation,
    VulnerabilityUrl,
    FirstFound,
    LastFound
| order by MaxCvss desc, LastFound desc
content.title: Findings detail
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range. Confirm the SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) is connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL.

content.json:
# BTP Responsible Contacts

During an incident you need a human to talk to. This view automatically infers a responsible contact for every SAP BTP subaccount, custom application (XSUAA app / Cloud Foundry app), service instance and Cloud Integration artifact by correlating `SAPBTPAuditLog_CL` entries. No watchlist or manual maintenance is required. Resources without a direct contact **fall back to the subaccount administrator**.

| Signal | Resource | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| Holds an administrator role collection (role collection assignment, resolved via SCIM) | Subaccount | High |
| Deployed / created the integration artifact | Integration artifact | High |
| Obtained admin-level cockpit scopes (CIS, Service Manager, XSUAA administration) | Subaccount | Medium |
| Obtained an administrative scope of the application (e.g. `myapp!t123.admin`) | Custom app | Medium |
| Created or modified the service instance | Service instance | Medium |
| Performed configuration changes | Subaccount | Low |
| Signed in to the application (shown as *App users*, never used as contact) | Custom app | Info |

**Limitations:** contacts reflect activity inside the selected lookback window (use a long window, e.g. 90 days); an administrator is not necessarily the business owner; Cloud Foundry space roles are not part of the BTP audit log, so CF apps are matched through their XSUAA app name. Select a row to see all evidence for the resource and its subaccount fallback candidates.

parameters.name: ContactSubaccount
parameters.label: Subaccount
parameters.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {ContactLookback:start}
| where isnotempty(SubaccountName)
| distinct SubaccountName
| sort by SubaccountName asc

content.query:
// Responsible contact resolution for SAP BTP resources (derived from SAPBTPAuditLog_CL only).
// Confidence: 1 = High, 2 = Medium, 3 = Low, 4 = app user (informational only).
let platform_apps = dynamic(["cis-local", "service-manager", "cockpit_xsuaa-api", "portal-cf-service",
    "ui5-flexibility-personalization", "application-vulnerability-report", "auditlog", "app-studio",
    "destination-xsappname", "connectivity-proxy", "feature-flags", "xsuaa", "hcp_onboarding"]);
let admin_role_collections = dynamic(["Subaccount Administrator", "Subaccount Service Administrator", "Cloud Connector Administrator"]);
let IsHuman = (u: string) { u has "@" and u !startswith "sb-" and u !startswith "client/" };
// Custom XSUAA app name from an OAuth client id; skips platform services and generated broker clones
let AppFromClient = (c: string) {
    let a = extract(@"^sb-([^!|]+)!", 1, c);
    iff(isempty(a) or a has_any (platform_apps) or a matches regex @"^(ut-|na-)?[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-", "", a)
};
let base = materialize(SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
    | where TimeGenerated >= {ContactLookback:start}
    | where "*" in ({ContactSubaccount}) or SubaccountName in ({ContactSubaccount}));
// Token issuance: who obtained which scopes on which client
let tokens = materialize(base
    | where Category == "audit.security-events" and Message has "TokenIssuedEvent"
    | extend m = tostring(parse_json(tostring(Message.data)).message)
    | extend Human = tolower(extract(@'"user_name"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, m)),
             ClientId = extract(@'"client_id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, m),
             GrantType = extract(@'"grant_type"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, m),
             Scopes = extract_all(@'"([^"]+)"', extract(@'"scope"\s*:\s*(\[[^\]]*\])', 1, m))
    | project TimeGenerated, SubaccountName, Tenant, Human, ClientId, GrantType, Scopes);
let human_scopes = tokens
    | where IsHuman(Human)
    | mv-expand Scope = Scopes to typeof(string);
// S2: privileged platform scopes (CIS write, Service Manager manage, XSUAA administration)
let s2 = human_scopes
    | where Scope matches regex @"^cis-local![bt]\d+\.subaccount\..*\.(create|update|delete)$"
        or Scope matches regex @"^service-manager![bt]\d+\.subaccount\..*\.manage$"
        or Scope in ("xs_authorization.write", "xs_user.write", "xs_idp.write")
    | summarize EvidenceCount = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Evidence = make_set(Scope, 5)
        by SubaccountName, Tenant, Contact = Human
    | extend ResourceType = "Subaccount", ResourceKey = SubaccountName, Signal = "Admin-scoped cockpit access", Confidence = 2;
// S6: app-local administrative scope on a custom app
let s6 = human_scopes
    | extend XsApp = extract(@"^([^!]+)![bt]\d+\.", 1, Scope), LocalScope = extract(@"^[^!]+![bt]\d+\.(.+)$", 1, Scope)
    | where isnotempty(XsApp) and isnotempty(AppFromClient(strcat("sb-", XsApp, "!")))
    | where LocalScope matches regex @"(?i)(admin|manage|write|config|owner|operator)"
    | summarize EvidenceCount = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Evidence = make_set(Scope, 5)
        by SubaccountName, Tenant, ResourceKey = XsApp, Contact = Human
    | extend ResourceType = "Custom app (XSUAA)", Signal = "App administrator scope", Confidence = 2;
// S8: interactive app users (informational, never used as primary contact)
let s8 = tokens
    | where IsHuman(Human) and GrantType == "authorization_code"
    | extend XsApp = AppFromClient(ClientId)
    | where isnotempty(XsApp)
    | summarize EvidenceCount = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Evidence = make_set(ClientId, 3)
        by SubaccountName, Tenant, ResourceKey = XsApp, Contact = Human
    | extend ResourceType = "Custom app (XSUAA)", Signal = "App user", Confidence = 4;
// Configuration events
let cfg = materialize(base
    | where Category == "audit.configuration" or isnotempty(Message.object)
    | extend Obj = parse_json(tostring(Message.object))
    | extend ObjType = tostring(Obj.type), ObjId = parse_json(tostring(Obj.id)));
// SCIM user id -> email, to resolve role collection assignees
let scim_map = cfg
    | where tostring(Message.object) has "scim user"
    | mv-expand Attr = parse_json(tostring(Message.attributes))
    | extend U = parse_json(replace_regex(tostring(Attr.new), @"\r", ""))
    | extend UserId = tostring(U.id), Email = tolower(coalesce(tostring(U.emails[0].value), tostring(U.userName)))
    | where isnotempty(UserId) and Email has "@"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Email) by Tenant, UserId
    | project Tenant, UserId, Email;
// S1: current holders of administrator role collections (latest CREATE not followed by DELETE)
let s1 = cfg
    | where tostring(Message.object) has "xs_rolecollection2user"
    | extend Crud = tostring(ObjId.crudType), RoleCollection = tostring(ObjId.rolecollection_name), UserId = tostring(ObjId.user_id)
    | where RoleCollection in (admin_role_collections)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Crud) by SubaccountName, Tenant, RoleCollection, UserId
    | where Crud != "DELETE"
    | join kind=leftouter scim_map on Tenant, UserId
    | extend Contact = tolower(iff(UserId has "@", UserId, Email))
    | where isnotempty(Contact)
    | summarize EvidenceCount = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Evidence = make_set(RoleCollection, 5)
        by SubaccountName, Tenant, Contact
    | extend ResourceType = "Subaccount", ResourceKey = SubaccountName, Signal = "Holds administrator role collection", Confidence = 1;
// S7: Cloud Integration artifact deployer / creator
let s7 = cfg
    | where ObjType in ("Deployment", "Undeployment")
    | mv-apply a = parse_json(tostring(Message.attributes)) on (
        summarize Artifact = take_anyif(tostring(coalesce(a.["new"], a.["old"])), tostring(a.name) == "symbolicName"),
                  Actor = take_anyif(tostring(coalesce(a.["new"], a.["old"])), tostring(a.name) in ("deployedBy", "undeployedBy", "creator")))
    | where IsHuman(Actor) and isnotempty(Artifact)
    | summarize EvidenceCount = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Evidence = make_set(ObjType, 2)
        by SubaccountName, Tenant, ResourceKey = Artifact, Contact = tolower(Actor)
    | extend ResourceType = "Integration artifact", Signal = "Artifact deployer / creator", Confidence = 1;
let human_cfg = cfg
    | where Category == "audit.configuration" and IsHuman(UserName);
// S3: human actors of configuration changes in the subaccount
let s3 = human_cfg
    | summarize EvidenceCount = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Evidence = make_set(ObjType, 5)
        by SubaccountName, Tenant, Contact = tolower(UserName)
    | extend ResourceType = "Subaccount", ResourceKey = SubaccountName, Signal = "Configuration change actor", Confidence = 3;
// S5: human creator / modifier of a service instance
let s5 = human_cfg
    | where ObjType has_any ("service_instance", "service instance", "serviceinstance")
    | extend ResourceKey = coalesce(tostring(ObjId.name), tostring(ObjId.service_instance_name), tostring(ObjId.id), tostring(ObjId))
    | summarize EvidenceCount = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Evidence = make_set(ObjType, 5)
        by SubaccountName, Tenant, ResourceKey, Contact = tolower(UserName)
    | extend ResourceType = "Service instance", Signal = "Instance creator / modifier", Confidence = 2;
let candidates = materialize(union s1, s2, s3, s5, s6, s7, s8
    | project ResourceType, SubaccountName, Tenant, ResourceKey, Contact, Signal, Confidence, EvidenceCount, LastSeen, Evidence);
// Ranked responsible contacts (app users excluded)
let ranked = candidates
    | where Confidence < 4
    | summarize Signals = make_set(Signal), BestConfidence = min(Confidence), Evidence = sum(EvidenceCount), LastSeen = max(LastSeen)
        by ResourceType, SubaccountName, Tenant, ResourceKey, Contact
    | sort by ResourceType asc, Tenant asc, ResourceKey asc, BestConfidence asc, Evidence desc, LastSeen desc
    | extend Rank = row_number(1, prev(ResourceType) != ResourceType or prev(Tenant) != Tenant or prev(ResourceKey) != ResourceKey);
let picked = materialize(ranked
    | summarize PrimaryContact = take_anyif(Contact, Rank == 1),
                PrimaryConfidence = take_anyif(BestConfidence, Rank == 1),
                PrimarySignals = take_anyif(Signals, Rank == 1),
